title: Understanding OLS Prediction Vector
text: The OLS prediction vector, denoted as hat{Y}, is a key concept in linear regression. It represents the predicted values of the dependent variable based on the independent variables.

title: Orthogonal Projection
text: In the context of linear regression, the orthogonal projection of a vector Y onto the span of another vector X is a way to find the closest point in the span of X to the vector Y.

hintAnswer: hat{Y} is the orthogonal projection of Y onto the span of X.
title: Identifying the Correct Interpretation
text: Consider the relationship between the vectors Y and X in the context of OLS. What does it mean for hat{Y} to be the orthogonal projection of Y onto the span of X?
choices: hat{Y} is the difference between Y and the orthogonal projection of Y onto the span of X.
hat{Y} is the orthogonal projection of Y onto the span of X.
When X is not full column rank, hat{Y} is still uniquely determined because the normal equation always has a single solution.
hat{Y} is the orthogonal projection of X onto the span of Y.
